resource:
resource "observe_correlation_tag" "ip_address" {
    column = "ip_address"
    dataset = resource.observe_dataset.new_one.oid
    name = "ip_address"
}

resource "observe_correlation_tag" "trace_id" {
    column = "FIELDS"
    dataset = resource.observe_dataset.new_one.oid
    name = "trace.id"
    path = trace_identifier
}


resource "observe_dataset" "new_one" {
    acceleration_disabled = false
    acceleration_type     = "materialized"
    description           = "First new dataset."
    entity_tags           = {}
    freshness             = "2m0s"
    icon_url              = "files/programming/log"
    inputs                = {
        "applogs"       = "o:::dataset:99000101"
        "missing_thing" = "o:::dataset:99999999"
        "peer"          = "o:::dataset:99001000"
        "sibling"       = "o:::dataset:99010002"
    }
    name                  = "Fake/New Dataset One"
    object_tags           = {}
    on_demand_materialization_length = "768h0m0s"
    workspace             = "o:::workspace:99000001"

    stage {
        alias        = "sub"
        input        = "peer"
        output_stage = false
        pipeline     = <<-EOT
            filter thing = "a"
            make_col brace_text:"{ not hcl }", oid_text:"o:::dataset:12345"
        EOT
    }

    stage {
        alias        = null
        input        = "applogs"
        output_stage = false
        pipeline     = <<-EOT
            union @sub
            pick_col BUNDLE_TIMESTAMP, FIELDS
        EOT
    }
}
